observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 127.» (L15) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 40: 35 stands beside the first line of the title.
body L31-L33: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type and centred; the title is in two lines.
body L18, L36: the letters of the references (t) and (a) are bold italic; with chapter 40 the letters begin again at a.
body L20: the comma after «divide» is printed low, under the line.
body L7, L24: specks stand after «[utrinque]» and after «quod»; they are not signs.

notes_left L1: the first figure of the denominator is printed filled, a closed shape with a waist like the 8 beside it; it is read as 3, the reading «iuxta cod. 1/38» of Nallino's note a) to chapter 40 (Part I, p. 264, L4), where both figures print clear.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
